name: important-mail-guard
description: Stars urgent mail that needs a reply and flags likely phishing. Never archives or trashes.

urgency.instructions: How soon does the recipient need to act on this email?
criteria: Can wait or needs no action

needs_reply.instructions: The sender is waiting for the recipient to reply.

criteria.true: A direct question or request addressed to the recipient

is_phishing.instructions: This message looks like phishing or a scam: it impersonates someone, pressures the reader, or asks for credentials or payment.

decisions.name: Star urgent mail that needs a reply
